metadata.title: FSSAI Mandatory Labelling & Display Statutory Rules
metadata.primary_regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
metadata.statutory_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

compliance_rules.title: Name of the Food
compliance_rules.description: The name of the food shall indicate the true nature of the food and shall be specific and not generic.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: खाद्य पदार्थ का नाम मुख्य लेबल पर स्पष्ट होना चाहिए जो भोजन की वास्तविक प्रकृति को दर्शाए।

compliance_rules.title: List of Ingredients
compliance_rules.description: Every packaged food shall declare a list of ingredients in descending order of their weight or volume at the time of manufacturing under heading 'Ingredients:'.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: पैकेज्ड भोजन पर उपयोग के घटते क्रम में 'Ingredients:' शीर्षक के तहत सभी सामग्रियों की सूची होनी चाहिए।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Single ingredient foods where the ingredient is identical to the name of food.

compliance_rules.title: Nutritional Information Panel
compliance_rules.description: Nutritional information per 100g/100ml or per serve: Energy (kcal), Protein (g), Carbohydrates (g), Total Sugars (g), Added Sugars (g), Total Fat (g), Saturated Fat (g), Trans Fat (g), and Sodium (mg).
compliance_rules.hindi_description: प्रति 100 ग्राम/मिली या प्रति सर्विंग ऊर्जा, प्रोटीन, कार्बोहाइड्रेट, चीनी, वसा और सोडियम की घोषणा अनिवार्य है।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Unprocessed foods, herbs, spices, coffee, tea, bottled water without added ingredients.

compliance_rules.title: Mandatory Allergen Declaration
compliance_rules.description: Mandatory declaration for cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, milk, eggs, fish, peanuts, tree nuts, soybeans, sulphites. Must clearly distinguish CONTAINS from precautionary MAY CONTAIN.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: ग्लूटेन, दूध, सोया, मूंगफली आदि प्रमुख 8 एलर्जी कारकों की 'CONTAINS' या 'MAY CONTAIN' के रूप में स्पष्ट घोषणा।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Foods not containing any of the 8 mandatory allergens and manufactured in dedicated lines free of cross-contact.

compliance_rules.title: Declaration regarding Veg or Non-Veg Symbol
compliance_rules.description: Every package of Vegetarian food shall bear a green colour filled circle inside a green square. Non-vegetarian food shall bear a brown colour filled triangle inside a brown square.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: शाकाहारी भोजन पर हरे चौकोर में हरा वृत्त और मांसाहारी भोजन पर भूरे चौकोर में भूरा त्रिकोण अनिवार्य है।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Carbonated water, liquid milk, mineral water, honey, alcoholic beverages.

compliance_rules.title: FSSAI Logo and 14-Digit Licence Number
compliance_rules.description: FSSAI logo and 14-digit licence number shall be displayed in format 'Lic. No. XXXXXXXXXXXXXX' on packaging.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: पैकेट पर FSSAI का लोगो और 14 अंकों का खाद्य लाइसेंस नंबर (Lic. No.) मुद्रित होना अनिवार्य है।

compliance_rules.title: Net Quantity Declaration
compliance_rules.description: Net quantity by weight, volume, or count declared in metric units (g, kg, ml, l) on principal display panel.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: पैकेट पर वजन या मात्रा (g, kg, ml, L में) स्पष्ट रूप से घोषित होनी चाहिए।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Packages containing less than 10g or 10ml, except tobacco.

compliance_rules.title: Batch / Lot / Code Identification
compliance_rules.description: Batch number or lot number or code number by which the food can be traced in manufacture and distribution.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: भोजन की ट्रेसबिलिटी के लिए बैच नंबर या लॉट नंबर घोषित होना अनिवार्य है।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Individual single-serve sachets packaged in an outer container bearing batch number.

compliance_rules.title: Date of Manufacture / Packaging & Expiry / Best Before
compliance_rules.description: Date of manufacture/packaging AND Expiry date / Best Before / Use By date in DD/MM/YY or MM/YY format.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: निर्माण की तिथि (Mfg Date) और समाप्ति तिथि (Expiry / Best Before / Use By) स्पष्ट रूप से दर्ज होनी चाहिए।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Fresh fruits and vegetables, wine, vinegar, sugar, chewing gum, salt.

compliance_rules.title: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Marketer
compliance_rules.title_hi: निर्माता का नाम और पूरा पता
compliance_rules.description: Name and complete physical postal address of manufacturer and packing premises, or marketing brand owner.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: निर्माता या विपणक का पूरा नाम, पता, राज्य और देश स्पष्ट होना चाहिए।

compliance_rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) & Consumer Care Details
compliance_rules.title_hi: अधिकतम खुदरा मूल्य (MRP) और ग्राहक सेवा संपर्क
compliance_rules.description: Maximum Retail Price (MRP inclusive of all taxes) and consumer care contact: telephone/toll-free number and email address.
compliance_rules.hindi_description: अधिकतम खुदरा मूल्य (MRP) और उपभोक्ता शिकायत के लिए टोल-फ्री नंबर या ईमेल दर्ज होना अनिवार्य है।
compliance_rules.exemptions: Institutional consumer packages sold directly without retail sale.
